purpose: Core 0.18 observation-first discovery dispositions for frozen 1.1 cold discrepancies

nei_guard: NEI DISTINCT lineages do not imply independent evidence
NEI SAME lineage does not imply same evidence-event identity
discovery_result.open: safe derived lineage predicate from exact proof/evidence topology

cautions: The authority already models event and lineage as distinct first-class quantities.
Treat this as ordinary summarization substitution unless new evidence shows otherwise.

cross_case_synthesis.statement: Cold reconstruction can substitute an adjacent semantic projection/aggregation/derived layer for the requested explicit representation layer.
Direct comparison should align subject, predicate/quantity, representation layer, aggregation level, scope/view, authority revision, closure assumptions, and value.
Across R0044, R0074, and bounded SIU-1, fine-grained referents can remain DISTINCT while an explicitly scoped/profiled projection supports SAME, with fine residual/provenance preserved.
cross_case_synthesis.constraint: Projection may be context-scoped; evidence artifact-to-lineage is not globally functional.

cross_case_synthesis.statement: Standard 7x6 same-q future-behavior identity is an explicit NEI closure target: prove complete SAME coverage or find a same-q pair with differing load-bearing future behavior.

nei_enabled_rerun.conclusion: NEI materially improves identity-shaped discovery while remaining not applicable to non-identity branches.
